Management expects the RAC segment to grow broadly in line with the industry growth of 20–22% in FY27, with the industry having grown 18% YoY in H1FY27.

However, CD margins are expected to remain under pressure due to commodity inflation, forex fluctuations, minimum wage revisions and ramp-up costs at the Sri City facility, with a 50–100bps impact on FY27 margins.
Management expects to receive SEBI approval for the IL JIN Electronics IPO within the next 3–4 months, followed by a one-year window to launch the issue.
